What it solves: ## What is wanted (common to every branch)

   at mint), called from `swarmforge.sh` for any pack with a driver
   seat (BL-1697's definition): the newest BL-1700/BL-1701 summary for
   the seat's model must record at least 4 o…
Approval context: This is the choice the intake said must come back to you before it is specified (its slice L4, "local packs run the coordinator deterministically"), widened by one question the intake left open: who runs the review stages (cleaner, architect, hardender…
